shared_elements: figures arranged in loose horizontal rows/registers
small isolated marks or dots alongside larger figures
justification: Both surfaces carry profile animal figures distributed in loosely stacked horizontal rows, and both include repeated curved, crescent-like outlines, which is about the extent of the correspondence. The manner of execution is wholly different: A is thin red pigment drawn in open linear outline on a lichen-blotched natural rock face, while B is dense, deeply cut low relief with modelled volumes, framing bands and rows of repeated motifs on a dressed stone block.
